Claude·Coming soon

Ask Claude to work on your model.

Connect MeshOptimiser to Claude and describe the job in plain words. Claude looks at the scene, finds what is heavy and does the clean-up in the app, in front of you. Anything that changes the model asks first, and every change can be undone.

How it works Read the docs

How it works

Three steps, then just ask.

  1. 01

    Switch it on

    In MeshOptimiser open Settings, choose Claude, and turn on Let Claude connect. A small “Claude connected” pill shows in the top bar while it is on.

  2. 02

    Add it to Claude

    Once, in a terminal on the same computer. This points Claude at the app. Nothing is installed.

  3. 03

    Ask

    Describe the job in plain words. Claude calls the app’s tools one at a time and tells you what it did.

Add it to Claude
claude mcp add --transport http meshoptimiser http://localhost:4242/mcp

The command is for Claude Code. Another program that can add an HTTP MCP server takes the same address: http://localhost:4242/mcp. If the launcher printed a different port, use that number.

What Claude can do

The app’s own tools, in Claude’s hands.

Look

See the scene as you see it.

  • scene_summaryThe file, parts, triangles, size, view mode and explode state.
  • list_partsEvery part with its triangles, size and colour; sorted, filtered, paged.
  • get_selectionWhat is selected right now.
  • screenshotA picture of the viewport.

Show you around

Select, hide, turn and explode. Nothing is changed, so none of it asks.

  • select_partsSelect by id or part of a name; add or remove.
  • select_allSelect every visible part, or invert the selection.
  • hide_partsHide parts.
  • isolate_partsShow only these parts.
  • show_allBring everything back.
  • frame_selectionFly to the selection.
  • set_camera_viewPerspective, top, front, side, or fit the model.
  • set_view_modeSolid, wireframe, x-ray, heat, clay or CAD.
  • set_explodePull the parts apart along any axes, 0 to 300%.
  • set_gridShow or hide the grid.

Find things

Questions with an answer.

  • find_fastenersBolts, screws, nuts and washers, found by their shape and selected.
  • find_stacked_copiesParts drawn twice in the same place; the extra copies are selected.
  • measure_partsThe distance between two parts, and the gap between their boxes.
  • list_groupsThe groups in the tree.

Make it lighter

Each one asks you first, and each one is a single undo step.

  • decimateReduce the triangles of chosen parts, to a target or by a share.asks
  • fit_to_budgetReduce the whole scene to a triangle budget.asks
  • fill_holesClose bolt holes, slots and pockets up to a size.asks
  • remove_hidden_facesDelete faces that can never be seen from outside.asks
  • repair_meshJoin doubled vertices, remove empty triangles, turn faces the same way.asks
  • clean_upRemove empty parts, share duplicate geometry, repair bad triangles.asks
  • merge_partsMerge parts into one mesh.asks
  • merge_by_colourOne mesh per colour.asks
  • split_partsBreak a mesh into its separate pieces.asks

Tidy and arrange

Names, groups and positions.

  • rename_partsRename by id, or find and replace, prefix and suffix.asks
  • group_partsPut parts in a group.asks
  • ungroupDissolve a group.asks
  • duplicate_partsCopy parts.asks
  • transform_partsMove, turn and scale parts.asks
  • recenter_modelPut the middle of the model at the origin.asks
  • align_to_floorStand the model on the floor.asks

Delete

Always asks, even when you switch asking off for the rest.

  • delete_partsDelete chosen parts.asks
  • remove_small_partsDelete every part under a size.asks

Files

On your own computer; nothing is uploaded.

  • open_fileOpen a model from a path on this computer.
  • export_modelSave a GLB, glTF, FBX, USDZ, OBJ or STL, or use a preset for the web, AR, Unreal, Unity or printing.
  • turntable_videoSave a turntable video of the model.

Scenes and history

The tabs and the undo history.

  • scene_tabsList the scene tabs, switch, open a new one.
  • undoTake back the last steps.
  • redoDo them again.

You stay in charge

Nothing changes without your say.

Claude works in your window, on your computer, and the app decides what it may do, not Claude.

It asks first
Anything that changes the model shows an Allow or Don’t allow prompt over the model. Looking, selecting, hiding and moving the camera do not.
Four switches
Settings › Claude has one switch each for changing the model, moving and renaming, deleting, and files. A switch that is off refuses the request, and Claude is told why.
Deleting always asks
Even if you turn asking off for everything else.
One undo each
Every change is a step in the app’s own history. Ctrl + Z takes it back, and so can Claude.
Off until you switch it on
One switch connects it, one switch ends it, and the top bar says when it is on. Settings lists what Claude asked for, and what you answered.

What leaves the computer

The app talks to Claude only through a small server that listens on your own computer. Your model file is not sent anywhere.

Claude gets back what its requests return: part names, counts, sizes and the pictures it asks for, such as a screenshot of the viewport. Those pass through Claude the way anything you type to it does.

Saved files, exports and turntable videos go to the app’s exports folder on your computer.

Try asking

Plain words are enough.

  • Find all the bolts and hide them.

  • Get this under 300,000 triangles and tell me what you took out.

  • Show it exploded 50% and take a screenshot.

  • Which ten parts carry the most triangles?

  • Rename every part that starts with “body” to “Housing”.

  • Remove the hidden faces from the ten heaviest parts.

  • Find parts that sit on a copy of themselves and remove the extras.

  • Stand the model on the floor and make a turntable video.

Questions

Before you try it.

What do I need?
MeshOptimiser running on your computer, with the app open in a browser tab, and Claude with MCP support: Claude Code, or any client that can add an HTTP MCP server.
Is it on by default?
No. The app does not listen for Claude until you switch on Let Claude connect, and it forgets the connection when you switch it off.
Does it work in the demo?
No. The hosted demo has no connection to Claude. Run the app on your own computer.
What if I want it to ask less, or not at all?
Switch off Ask before Claude edits. Deleting still asks unless you also switch off Always ask before deleting. Or turn a whole kind of edit off with its own switch.
Can Claude break my model?
Not past the undo history. Every change is a step you can take back, and your file on disk is only changed when you export.

Run it on your own machine.

Free and open source under the MIT licence. Windows and macOS; your files never leave the computer.
